description: The economic group of a Brazilian company by its CNPJ: the companies that control it (its partners that are companies, up to two levels) and the companies its group's head controls (subsidiaries and acquired companies that keep their own CNPJ), each with its CNPJ, legal name, main activity (CNAE) and status at the Receita (inactive ones flagged), plus the group's active factories. Free: registry lookups only. Also: how many active branches (filiais) the company has and in which states, and the companies that share partners with it (sócios em comum; linked, not necessarily controlled; the partner is never named). Answers questions about the head office CNPJ, a group's companies ("as filhas", "as compradas"), the branches, or whether a company is still active. Requires the CNPJ. The registry shows what the Receita has: foreign controllers and shareholders of an S.A. are not listed.

cnpj.description: The company's CNPJ, with or without punctuation.
